ID photo fitter

Crop, resize and compress a photo to match what Emirates ID, Daman or any portal asks for. Everything happens on your phone. The photo is never uploaded.

Set this to the limit in the portal's error message.
Working...

Pick a clear photo with your face straight to the camera. You can also drag a photo here, or paste one with Ctrl+V.

Drag to move. Pinch or use the slider to zoom. Keep your head inside the oval.
Zoom1.00×
Straighten0.0°
Brightness1.00
Evens out left and right light, corrects colour cast, and lifts dark or bright photos.
Soften shadows45%
Fills in shadows on the face and neck, like a soft front light.
Clarity10%
De-blur
For out-of-focus or shaky photos. Pick the lowest level that looks clearer. On a photo that is already sharp it adds grain, so leave it Off.
Sharpness15%
Makes soft photos crisper. It can't add detail the camera didn't capture.
Cut-out edge25%
Raise it if a thin dark outline remains. Lower it if hair or shoulders get nibbled.
Rebuilds a small or soft photo to look cleaner and sharper, then blends it with your original so the face stays true. Takes 10 to 40 seconds. If it looks too smooth, untick it or use hold-to-compare.
Works best against a plain wall. Turn it off if a halo of the old background shows.
Brush size30
Restore paints back parts of you that were cut out, like hair or a hair tie. Erase removes leftover background. Fixes stay while you use the sliders and clear if you move or zoom the photo.
If saving is unavailable, press and hold the photo above and choose Save to Photos.
When to retake instead of fixing
  • Glare covering your eyes or glasses.
  • Harsh shadow across half your face.
  • Expression, eyes or head angle. These can't be edited on an ID photo.
  • A very busy background or other people close behind you, which can confuse the cut-out.
  • Photo older than 6 months.
Sizes follow the published ICP specifications. Portals can change them, so check the requirement shown on the upload screen.
